sanskrit_verse:
अन्ये ऽपि शङ्कया ग्राह्या जातिनामादिनिह्नवैः ।
द्यूतस्त्रीपानसक्ताश च शुष्कभिन्नमुखस्वराः ॥
transliteration: anye 'pi śaṅkayā grāhyā jātināmādinihnavaiḥ | dyūtastripānasaktāś ca śuṣkabhinnamukhasvarāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who conceal their true nature through false identity, gambling addiction, intoxication, or altered voice and countenance shall be recognized by suspicion alone, and their capacity for dharma shall be restored through reintegration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with svadharma, not external appearance
Causation lies in internal dissonance manifesting as behavioral distortion
Capacity-based responsibility requires restoration of self-integrity
Restoration logic demands recognition of concealed truth through discernment
Consciousness alignment occurs when pretense is dissolved through insight
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person exhibits inconsistent identity markers OR behavioral anomalies linked to substance/gambling dependency THEN initiate consciousness-based inquiry
IF concealment of identity is detected via pramāṇa THEN assign completion process under spiritual supervision
IF vocal/physical demeanor indicates internal conflict THEN trigger restorative protocol for integrity realignment
IF individual demonstrates habitual avoidance of dharma THEN activate nyāya-based reintegration sequence
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, such individuals must not be judged based on surface-level inconsistencies but assessed through yogic pramāṇa to determine root causes. The court must invoke dharma-adhikāri protocols that bypass punitive frameworks and restore constitutional alignment at the level of consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals causal layers behind distorted behavior. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how concealment manifests progressively. Proportional response aligns with dissolution of pretense rather than imposition of penalty. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction arises naturally once falsehood is seen clearly.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śuddhi-kriyā (purification process) to remove addictive impressions
Assign sākṣātkāra-darśana (direct realization practice) to dissolve false identification
Establish guru-disciple relationship to realign personal dharma-path
Implement satya-pratiṣṭhāpana (truth-establishment ritual) to reinstate authentic voice and presence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: all concealment dissolves before awakened discernment; dharma prevails through consciousness restoration, never through punishment. Reality itself corrects where awareness awakens.
